title: Happy chameleon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='body' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4ee06a'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#2fc35a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#8bf06a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tail' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#2fc35a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#f2c94c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- curled tail -->
  <path d='M30 58 C18 58 12 68 18 76 C24 84 36 82 36 72 C36 65 30 62 26 66 C23 69 26 74 30 72'
        fill='none' stroke='#f2c94c' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- back ridge -->
  <path d='M32 44 L40 36 L46 42 L54 32 L60 40 L68 30 L74 38 L82 32 L86 42'
        fill='none' stroke='#1f9c46' stroke-width='3' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='58' rx='32' ry='20' fill='url(#body)'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='64' rx='20' ry='9' fill='#b6f58a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d='M44 74 L38 84 M38 84 L30 86 M38 84 L44 86' stroke='#1f9c46' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- front leg -->
  <path d='M72 74 L72 84 M72 84 L64 87 M72 84 L80 87' stroke='#1f9c46' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='82' cy='44' r='17' fill='#3fd467'/>
  <!-- casque/crest -->
  <path d='M84 30 Q94 20 96 32 Q92 34 88 34 Z' fill='#8bf06a'/>
  <!-- eye turret -->
  <circle cx='86' cy='42' r='8' fill='#2fb552'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='42' r='5' fill='#fdf6c9'/>
  <circle cx='87' cy='42' r='2.6' fill='#123d1f'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M74 52 Q80 58 89 54' fill='none' stroke='#123d1f' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- tongue flick -->
  <path d='M92 50 L98 46' stroke='#ff6ea8' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='98' cy='46' r='2' fill='#ff6ea8'/>
</svg>
